Saved opening journeys captured from main commit `93cf190d93a714e574ed09844dc42b40e190a08c`, rules 103, Greek revision 20. Each file is gzip-compressed JSON from `openingFixture(branch, options)` in that commit. The late-report case uses `reportFirst: false`; the dry case uses `water: false`. These preserve the retired burial, concession and exposure paths for save-upgrade and later-journey checks. New funeral play is tested in `card-polynices-funeral.test.mjs`.
